title: Copy Trial
statement: Let $M_V$, $M_I$, and $M_P$ be Boolean finite-state Turing machines, and let $x$ and $u$ be Boolean words. Starting with input-head position $1$, the first tape storing $u$, the second tape storing $x$, and the copying phase active, the copy machine reaches after $2|u|+2$ steps a configuration in its done phase with the first tape still storing $u$ and the second storing $x\mathbin{++}u$. Before that time it never enters the done phase, and at every time up to and including that time, every work-tape head has absolute position at most $|x|+|u|+1$.
hypotheses_covered: $M_V$, $M_I$, and $M_P$ are Boolean finite-state Turing machines
